summary.text: KathleenMae Rogers, an independent write-in candidate for Missouri's 4th District, lost the November 3, 2026 election to Mark Alford.
A Marine Corps veteran and graduate student whose research focuses on post-traumatic stress disorder treatment and access to treatment, she has not held public office.

paragraphs.text: Rogers has said she ran as an independent write-in candidate so that residents would have someone who would represent them rather than partisan interests.
Rogers lost to Mark Alford, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
